title: Everyday Phrases — A Parent-and-Baby Group
scene_zh: 其他家長 · 情境對話
title_quote: Here we are at the center.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】👶 實用「親子遊戲班」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Parent-and-Baby Group
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「親子遊戲班」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是其他家長：帶寶寶去親子遊戲班：到活動中心報到、脫鞋放好推車，一起唱遊律動，寶寶哭了、也搶了玩具，點心時間跟其他家長聊作息與副食品，最後收玩具、道別、推車回家午睡。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'A Parent-and-Baby Group' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A parent-and-baby group: signing in, singing and moving together, a tearful moment over a toy, snack time chat about naps and weaning, and the walk home for a nap. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we are at the center.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The door is already open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the baby group room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the second door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we check in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check in at the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, we are here to play.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ wi ɑr hɪr tu ple/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, please sign the list first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write my baby's name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please write the time as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use this blue pen?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pen works just fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the number on my slip?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑn maɪ slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我單子上的號碼是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is printed at the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to pay today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is already paid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put the stroller?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Park it beside the shoe rack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there space near the wall?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the corner has some room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our stroller is a bit heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can help you push it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, that is very kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, we all help.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，大家都會互相幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my baby need a name tag?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz maɪ ˈbeɪbi nid ə neɪm tæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please stick it on his shirt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we take off shoes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, on the blue mat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wear socks inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Socks are better for the floor.
dialogue.zh: 穿襪子在地板上比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My baby keeps pulling his shoes.
dialogue.zh: 我的寶寶一直拉他的鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants to walk already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold him a moment?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, give him to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our baby is heavier this week.
dialogue.zh: 我們的寶寶這週又重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Babies grow so very fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which shelf is for our shoes?
dialogue.zh: 哪一層架子放我們的鞋？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lower shelf is for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these cubbies for the bags?
dialogue.zh: 這些格子是放包包的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put your bag in one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cubby has a small picture.
dialogue.zh: 這個格子上有一張小圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That picture shows a yellow duck.
dialogue.zh: 那張圖是一隻黃色小鴨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we should use another cubby.
dialogue.zh: 也許我們該用別的格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the next one is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the class start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts in five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the class today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lasts about one hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We still have time to settle.
dialogue.zh: 我們還有時間安頓一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are quite early today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me take off his jacket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This room is warm enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave his blanket here?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把他的毯子放在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it on the small hook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the floor too cold for him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə flɔr tu koʊld fɔr hɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the mat is soft and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə mæt ɪz sɔft ænd wɔrm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are full right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will open the door for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈoʊpən ðə dɔr fɔr ju/

dialogue.text: Thank you, that is a big help.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðæt ɪz ə bɪɡ hɛlp/
dialogue.speaker: char_a
char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome, take your time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see the other babies?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some are crawling on the mat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son loves watching other kids.
dialogue.zh: 我兒子很愛看其他小朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will make friends soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the teacher standing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is near the piano corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is that lady in red?
dialogue.zh: 那位穿紅衣服的女士是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the baby group leader.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I introduce myself to her?
dialogue.zh: 我該去跟她自我介紹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She likes meeting new parents.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we sit on the big rug?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi sɪt ɑn ðə bɪɡ rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以坐在大毯子上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any free spot is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stroller is blocking the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me move it over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This spot looks better for the stroller.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs spɑt lʊks ˈbɛtər fɔr ðə ˈstroʊlər/
dialogue.zh: 這個位置好像更適合放推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is out of the way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our shoes are in the right cubby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ʃuz ɑr ɪn ðə raɪt ˈkʌbi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, everything is in place.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the slip important to keep?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it in your pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I do with his hat?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ du wɪð hɪz hæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it inside your bag, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many diapers should I bring?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One or two is usually enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bathroom down the hall?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is next to the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I might need to change him later.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ maɪt nid tu tʃeɪndʒ hɪm ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 我等一下可能要幫他換尿布。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a changing room inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is smiling at the music.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds like he enjoys it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us find a place to sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs faɪnd ə pleɪs tu sɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are cushions near the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should he take his socks off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he can keep them on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the empty cup go here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on the low table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone looks ready to begin.
dialogue.zh: 大家好像都準備開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will start very soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it on time today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and he is wide awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we sing a song now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us sing together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hands clap to the music.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The teacher plays it again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everybody dances in a circle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold my hand and come here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He knows the words already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He sings it very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is he not singing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is just watching us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we move our feet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hop on the spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drum sounds too loud today.
dialogue.zh: 今天鼓聲聽起來太大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover your ears for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like this funny song?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡這首有趣的歌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it makes me laugh.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you wave your hands slowly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am waving now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please sit on the mat quietly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am sitting down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did your baby go now?
dialogue.zh: 你的寶寶現在跑去哪了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is behind the big box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He wants to hold the ball.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to him now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We pass the ball to friends.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a nice game.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is crying very loudly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe he is tired now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want a short break?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I need some water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that boy unhappy?
dialogue.zh: 那個男孩為什麼不開心？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He lost his favorite toy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have my toy back?
dialogue.zh: 我可以拿回我的玩具嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, take it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He took the baby's toy.
dialogue.zh: 他把寶寶的玩具拿走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We should share the toys.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could they play with one block?
dialogue.zh: 他們可以一起玩一塊積木嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they can take turns.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we stop the crying?
dialogue.zh: 我們要怎麼讓寶寶不哭？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sing a quiet song softly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My baby hugs the soft bear.
dialogue.zh: 我的寶寶抱著那隻軟熊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That bear always helps him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His tears are almost gone now.
dialogue.zh: 他的眼淚現在幾乎沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He looks calm and sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear the music stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that song is over.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They sit down for the story.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The teacher opens a big book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I sit next to you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is space here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you clap with the music?
dialogue.zh: 你可以跟著音樂拍手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I clap very fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The baby smiles at the song.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He likes the happy tune.
dialogue.zh: 他喜歡這首輕快的曲子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We dance with our little ones.
dialogue.zh: 我們跟小寶寶一起跳舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They love this gentle movement.
dialogue.zh: 他們很愛這種輕輕的動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are you laughing so much?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tickle game is funny.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold my hand and jump high.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We jump like a frog.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is drumming on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him the small drum.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we sway to the music.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們跟著音樂搖擺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My baby sways with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please give the toy to him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says thank you nicely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He took the toy again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him to give it back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they share the red car?
dialogue.zh: 他們會一起玩那台紅車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they take turns nicely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His face is getting red.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe he needs a clean diaper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I hold him for a while?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl aɪ hoʊld hɪm fɔr ə waɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my arms are tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We sit and breathe slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That always calms him down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is his soft blanket now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is inside the blue bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How can I help your baby?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sing him a quiet song.
dialogue.zh: 唱一首安靜的歌給他聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is clapping with the group.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves the drumming part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now he is crawling to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is faster than yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the song finished now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everyone is clapping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We all sit on the mat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The babies sit beside us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He waves at the other babies.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They wave back at him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this a fun clapping game?
dialogue.zh: 這是好玩的拍手遊戲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is really fun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The boy gives the block back.
dialogue.zh: 那個男孩把積木還回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now they play together again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we put the toys away?
dialogue.zh: 我們把玩具收起來好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the box is right there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the babies be hungry now?
dialogue.zh: 寶寶們現在可能餓了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe they need a snack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like one more song?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the babies love singing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it snack time now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the mats are ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we wash hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sink is by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my son sit with Leo?
dialogue.zh: 我兒子可以跟 Leo 一起坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, there is space here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you bring today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I brought bananas and rice cakes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does Leo eat rice cakes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves them with yogurt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is Leo now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He just turned ten months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my son too young for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ sʌn tu jʌŋ fɔr ðɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he can try a bite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My baby still wakes at night.
dialogue.zh: 我的寶寶晚上還是會醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine did that last month too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many times does he wake?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually two or three times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feed him at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only water, not milk now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When did Leo sleep through?
dialogue.zh: Leo 什麼時候睡過夜的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around eight months, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is your bedtime routine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bath, book, then a bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he use a pacifier?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he stopped it already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the room dark enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use a small night light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son naps only thirty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is short but normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you stretch the nap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I walk him in the stroller.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What solids does Leo like?
dialogue.zh: Leo 喜歡吃什麼副食品？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He likes sweet potato and avocado.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you tried egg yolk yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he ate it twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he have any reaction?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rash, just a little gas.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which spoon do you use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soft one with a long handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔft wʌn wɪð ə lɔŋ ˈhændəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the puree still warm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It cooled down a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I taste this porridge?
dialogue.zh: 我可以嚐一口這個粥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, it is not salty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who made these little biscuits?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Amy baked them this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they safe for babies?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are soft and unsweetened.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for sharing your snacks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, we always bring extra.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is his last nap?
dialogue.zh: 他最後一次小睡是幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He naps around three o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he eat before his nap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a small cup of milk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which brand of formula is that?
dialogue.zh: 那是哪個牌子的配方奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I mix two kinds together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you still nursing him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, but he takes a bottle.
dialogue.zh: 大部分是，但他會喝奶瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you warm the bottle?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put it in warm water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My baby refuses vegetables lately.
dialogue.zh: 我的寶寶最近不吃蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try mixing them with pumpkin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he like the pumpkin mash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he finished the whole bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you offer water daily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just half a cup each day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you give the yogurt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After his afternoon nap, usually.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who watches Leo at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My husband takes the late shift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you two take turns?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we swap every other night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you getting enough sleep?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, but coffee helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which sound helps him sleep?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White noise and a soft blanket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could that blanket be safe for him?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðæt ˈblæŋkɪt bi seɪf fɔr hɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is very thin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can his nap last an hour?
dialogue.zh: 他的小睡能有一小時嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sometimes even longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you tried a later nap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, his schedule is fixed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He cries a lot at bedtime.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try rocking him a bit longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which songs do you sing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same two songs always.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have that recipe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will send it later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these crackers homemade?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with oats and banana.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have his teeth come in yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four on top, two below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He can chew the soft ones, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæn tʃu ðə sɔft wʌnz raɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if I cut them small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you leave today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right after this snack ends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for all the good tips.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us talk again next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My baby likes your son's cup.
dialogue.zh: 我的寶寶喜歡你兒子的杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can bring a spare one.
dialogue.zh: 我可以多帶一個備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the soft blocks in here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I am helping you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the cars belong?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They go in the yellow box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please pick up the red ball.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put it in the basket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this your blue car?
dialogue.zh: 這是你的藍色小汽車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it belongs to Ben.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us clean the mat together.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hold the dustpan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you carry two blocks?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my hands are big.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This puzzle goes on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put it up there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every toy has a place here.
dialogue.zh: 每個玩具在這裡都有位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the room looks tidy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The teacher says the box is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtitʃər sɛz ðə bɑks ɪz fʊl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can bring another one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the baby's shoes on now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is the left shoe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready to say bye?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will wave first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wave to Miss Lin and Ben.
dialogue.zh: 跟林老師和 Ben 揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye bye, see you next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say thank you to the teacher.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for the nice class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to say bye to everyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye bye, have a nice day.
dialogue.zh: 掰掰，祝你有美好的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us get the stroller now.
It is by the front desk.
dialogue.speaker: char_b
char_a
dialogue.text: The floor looks clean again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We worked very fast today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bear is in this box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take it home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This goes in the blue bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then all the toys are tidy.
dialogue.zh: 這樣所有玩具都整齊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These are yours to hold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, they are light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you stack the cups?
dialogue.zh: 你可以把杯子疊起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can stack five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We missed one block over there.
dialogue.zh: 那邊有一塊積木沒收到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will get it right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please thank Miss Lin before leaving.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, Miss Lin, see you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your shoes are by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put them on myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you put your coat on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is already in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want one last hug?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a big warm hug.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone is waving to us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am waving back at them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time for us to go home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am quite sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your little hat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is inside the stroller bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you walk to the gate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I want the stroller.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look sleepy, my little one.
dialogue.zh: 你看起來想睡了，小寶貝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my eyes feel heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we push the stroller home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will hold the handle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The street is quiet this evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can hear a little bird.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost home, the nap is near.
dialogue.zh: 快到家了，午睡時間快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will close my eyes soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we are, our building.
dialogue.zh: 我們到了，就是我們的大樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see the green door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me lift you out gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am ready for my nap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your soft blanket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the small bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet dreams, my little baby.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night night, see you soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the baby monitor on now?
dialogue.zh: 嬰兒監視器現在開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I turned the volume down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the room temperature tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is cozy, not too warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I rinse his empty bottle?
dialogue.zh: 我要沖一下他的空奶瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, leave it in the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I close the curtains fully?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the streetlight is quite bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the toys in the box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, even the little red car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did Leo enjoy most today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loved the drums and dancing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son clapped at every song.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leo watched him with big eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you come again next week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if the weather stays nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you dim the small lamp?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will make it dimmer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I check on him once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tʃɛk ɑn hɪm wʌns mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我要再去看看他一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one quiet look is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is his blanket tucked in properly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he is fast asleep now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us talk in a whisper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep my voice low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, my sweet boy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night night, we love you.

issues.note: 夜醒線時態略鬆（非 error）：b 於 215 說「Mine did that last month too.」（過去）後，217「Usually two or three times.」、219「Only water, not milk now.」為現在式，220-221 又說 Leo「Around eight months」已睡過夜。可合理讀成「上月睡眠倒退、醒時只給水」，非硬矛盾，下輪可統一語態。
結尾段（352-399）b 先以想睡的寶寶聲位應答（353、357、359、369），375 起轉回成人照顧者聲位（375「Yes, I turned the volume down.」、379「leave it in the kitchen.」）。依 brief 第 12 條，朗讀聲部切換不算缺陷（未出現同一把聲音扮角色又將該角色作第三人稱談論），僅記錄不列 error。

個別用詞略高於 A2 或偏英式：309「dustpan」、247「unsweetened」、242「porridge」（美式多作 oatmeal/cereal）；124「We pass the ball to friends.」帶輕微翻譯腔（母語者多說 to each other / to your friend），286「Can I have that recipe?」指涉略鬆（前文僅有 244-249 餅乾）。皆為可理解的單詞層面小瑕，未成句法或用詞錯誤。

review.summary_zh: 本輪修正到位：13 已非同義複述、170-173 與 180-185 換成新內容（紅臉→換尿布→接手抱；拍手打鼓→爬行），362「this evening」與結尾 tonight／Good night 一致，78 亦不再與外題撞句；僅餘夜醒時態鬆、結尾聲位切換偏快與個別超綱／英式用詞等非 error 級小瑕，予以通過。
